act.name: Human Immunodeficiency Virus and Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017
act.source_authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
act.description: Rights-based central law prohibiting HIV-related discrimination and protecting consent, confidentiality, treatment and grievance rights.

sections.title: Prohibition of discrimination.
sections.text: Section 3 prohibits specified discrimination against protected persons; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: A person living with or affected by HIV is protected from specified discrimination in employment, education, healthcare, housing and services.
